packet.headline_seed: Fireworks illuminate Barcelona's Sagrada Família during Pope visit
packet.description_seed: Pope Leo XIV says Barcelona's iconic Sagrada Família is a masterpiece of "stones, colours and light" during his visit to Spain.

clean_source_blocks.text: Pope Leo XIV says Barcelona's iconic Sagrada Família is a masterpiece of "stones, colours and light" during his visit to Spain.

Pope Leo XIV has described Barcelona's Sagrada Família as a masterpiece of "stones, colours and light" as he inaugurated its newest - and tallest - tower. The giant Tower of Jesus Christ, completed in February, has brought the church to a soaring height of 172.5m (566ft) - cementing it as the tallest church in the world. His visit to the iconic basilica also marks 100 years since the death of its architect, Antoni Gaudí. Among those attending the service were Spanish royals King Felipe VI and Queen Letizia, as well as Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez. The pope's week-long visit to Spain, which began on Saturday, is the first by a pope in some 15 years. Two men were injured in the explosion and were taken to hospital with minor injuries.

Pope Leo XIV attends the inauguration of the Tower of Jesus Christ at the Basilica of the Sagrada FamÃlia in Barcelona, Spain, Wednesday, June 10, 2026. Credit: AP/Emilio Morenatti BARCELONA, Spain — Pope Leo XIV celebrated the Sagrada Familia Basilica as a masterpiece of “stones, colors and light,” as he marked the centenary of the death of its architect, Antoni Gaudí, with a Mass on Wednesday to inaugurate its final soaring sandcastle spire. Leo called Gaudí’s unfinished temple, one of the world’s most visited monuments, a “sign of unity and harmony for all of Spain,” an ongoing building project like the lifelong journey all Christians make to find God.

An estimated 120,000 people lined the streets around Sagrada Familia for the event, with streets closed to traffic and a heavy police presence, given the attendance of the royal couple and Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez. The crowds remained after Mass to watch as Leo inaugurated the basilica's final Tower of Jesus Christ that has made it the world's tallest church. Speaking in Catalan and Spanish, Leo blessed the tower and its illuminated ceramic cross from outside the basilica, surrounded by bishops craning their mitre-capped heads to look up. An angelic boy's choir sang as a spectacular light show lit up the basilica's stained glass windows from the inside and fireworks shot off its facade. Pope Leo XIV arrives to attend a prayer vigil at Lluis Companys Olympic Stadium in Barcelona, Spain, Tuesday, June 9, 2026. Credit: AP/Emilio Morenatti

payload.title: Paavi Leo XIV vihki Sagrada Famílian korkeimman tornin Barcelonassa
payload.summary: Paavi Leo XIV osallistui Barcelonassa Sagrada Famílian Jeesuksen Kristuksen tornin vihkimiseen ja kuvaili basilikaa kivien, värien ja valon mestariteokseksi.
payload.content:
Paavi Leo XIV on vihkinyt Barcelonan Sagrada Famíliassa basilikan uuden Jeesuksen Kristuksen tornin, joka on tehnyt Antoni Gaudín suunnittelemasta kirkosta maailman korkeimman. Keskiviikkona 10. kesäkuuta 2026 järjestetty messu liittyi myös Gaudín kuoleman satavuotismuistoon, ja tapahtumaa seurasi arviolta 120 000 ihmistä basilikan ympäristössä.

## Tornin vihkiminen kokosi Barcelonaan väkeä

Sagrada Famílian ympäristön katuja suljettiin liikenteeltä tapahtuman ajaksi, ja paikalla oli vahva poliisinäkyvyys. Messuun osallistuivat myös Espanjan kuningas Felipe VI ja kuningatar Letizia sekä pääministeri Pedro Sánchez. Väkijoukko jäi messun jälkeen seuraamaan, kun paavi vihki basilikan viimeisen Jeesuksen Kristuksen tornin.

Paavi siunasi tornin ja sen valaistun keraamisen ristin basilikan ulkopuolelta. Lähteiden mukaan hän puhui tilaisuudessa katalaaniksi ja espanjaksi. Paikalla olleet piispat katsoivat ylös tornia kohti, kun poikakuoro lauloi ja valoesitys valaisi basilikan lasimaalauksia sisältä käsin. Julkisivulta ammuttiin myös ilotulitteita.

Jeesuksen Kristuksen torni valmistui helmikuussa. Sen myötä basilikan korkeus on 172,5 metriä eli 566 jalkaa, mikä nostaa rakennuksen maailman korkeimmaksi kirkoksi. BBC:n mukaan kyse on basilikan uusimmasta ja korkeimmasta tornista.

## Gaudín keskeneräinen temppeli sai uuden merkkipaalun

Leo XIV kuvaili Sagrada Famíliaa kivien, värien ja valon mestariteokseksi. Hän kutsui Gaudín yhä keskeneräistä temppeliä myös yhtenäisyyden ja harmonian merkiksi koko Espanjalle. Newsdayn mukaan hän vertasi keskeneräistä rakennushanketta kristittyjen elämänmittaiseen matkaan Jumalan löytämiseksi.

Vierailu on osa paavin viikon mittaista Espanjan-matkaa, joka alkoi lauantaina. Kyseessä on ensimmäinen paavin vierailu Espanjassa noin 15 vuoteen. Leo XIV:n ohjelmaan kuului myös rukoushetki Barcelonan Lluís Companysin olympiastadionilla tiistaina 9. kesäkuuta.

Sagrada Família on yksi maailman tunnetuimmista ja vierailluimmista nähtävyyksistä. Gaudín kuoleman satavuotismuisto antaa tämän vuoden juhlallisuuksille erityisen painon, sillä basilikan rakentaminen on jatkunut pitkään arkkitehdin kuoleman jälkeenkin.

Uusi torni nostaa basilikan 172,5 metrin korkeuteen ja maailman korkeimmaksi kirkoksi.
Tapahtuma liittyi Antoni Gaudín kuoleman satavuotismuistoon, ja paikalle kerääntyi arviolta 120 000 ihmistä.

Pope Leo XIV says Barcelona's iconic Sagrada Família is a masterpiece of "stones, colours and light" during his visit to Spain.

Pope Leo XIV has described Barcelona's Sagrada Família as a masterpiece of "stones, colours and light" as he inaugurated its newest - and tallest - tower. The giant Tower of Jesus Christ, completed in February, has brought the church to a soaring height of 172.5m (566ft) - cementing it as the tallest church in the world. His visit to the iconic basilica also marks 100 years since the death of its architect, Antoni Gaudí. Among those attending the service were Spanish royals King Felipe VI and Queen Letizia, as well as Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez. The pope's week-long visit to Spain, which began on Saturday, is the first by a pope in some 15 years. Two men were injured in the explosion and were taken to hospital with minor injuries.

Pope Leo XIV attends the inauguration of the Tower of Jesus Christ at the Basilica of the Sagrada FamÃlia in Barcelona, Spain, Wednesday, June 10, 2026. Credit: AP/Emilio Morenatti BARCELONA, Spain — Pope Leo XIV celebrated the Sagrada Familia Basilica as a masterpiece of “stones, colors and light,” as he marked the centenary of the death of its architect, Antoni Gaudí, with a Mass on Wednesday to inaugurate its final soaring sandcastle spire. Leo called Gaudí’s unfinished temple, one of the world’s most visited monuments, a “sign of unity and harmony for all of Spain,” an ongoing building project like the lifelong journey all Christians make to find God.

An estimated 120,000 people lined the streets around Sagrada Familia for the event, with streets closed to traffic and a heavy police presence, given the attendance of the royal couple and Prime Minister Pedro Sánchez. The crowds remained after Mass to watch as Leo inaugurated the basilica's final Tower of Jesus Christ that has made it the world's tallest church. Speaking in Catalan and Spanish, Leo blessed the tower and its illuminated ceramic cross from outside the basilica, surrounded by bishops craning their mitre-capped heads to look up. An angelic boy's choir sang as a spectacular light show lit up the basilica's stained glass windows from the inside and fireworks shot off its facade.
